title: What am I doing wrong with my Claude?
author: ParkInsider
selftext:
I'm not a dev, just a hobbyist.

I started working on a few different game ideas over the past month, all rather simple. The latest one I started, I decided to ask Claude to create a mini game studio skill and apply some of the insights found here and on other forums to make the development process more smooth, but it has been everything but that.

I now work with a plugin which simulates a game studio with a producer, a visual artist, a sound artist, a programmer, a QA tester and a writer. The idea is that my feedback is ran through a "standup" committee before starting to actual get worked on. I like the idea of that feature because on my previous game ideas, my suggestions were taken at face value and implemented without any pushback, and now the committee really pushes back and provides good alternatives, and the game direction is actually great - I'm excited to play it!

However, I'm incinerating tokens like never before. I was able to get to a playable version of two other games using about one week's tokens on the $20 plan. Now, for this game, I upgraded to the $200 plan and I have burned 40% of my weekly tokens in one day, with only two prompts, mind you. Sure, lots of changes in those prompts, but still, that's kind of crazy. It seems 1-2 orders of magnitude too much.

I let the "studio" run all night, just to see what they would end up with, and the QA is still running, 9 hours in!

The game has a lot of logic, maybe I scope creeped a bit too much, but still! 9+ hours of processing?

What am I doing wrong, what should I change?
